description:
Read a batch calling campaign

Returns one campaign with its current counters: how many numbers it holds and how many calls have succeeded, failed or are still waiting. `batchId` stays null until the campaign is submitted. The counters are the ones stored on the campaign record and are updated as call results arrive, so poll this endpoint to follow a running campaign. It is guarded by the `read:agents` scope rather than a scope of its own.

campaignId.description: Identifier of the campaign. A non-numeric value is rejected with 400.

name: get_call_campaign
title: Read a batch calling campaign
